name: Torres del Paine National Park
story: Torres del Paine National Park is a national park encompassing mountains, glaciers, lakes, and rivers in southern Chilean Patagonia. Established as a national park in 1959, it features the Cordillera del Paine group of mountains and granite peaks that rise 2,500 metres above sea level.
matters: The park lies in a transition area between the Magellanic subpolar forests and the Patagonian Steppes. It is designated as a World Biosphere Reserve by UNESCO.
